title: Deploy is a step. Verification is the gate.
summary: A release moves from staging into a deployment slot. Traffic remains closed until verification; only then does the new version become live.

cues.title: Load the new release
cues.text: The deployment slot receives the package; customer traffic is still closed.

cues.title: Verify before opening traffic
cues.text: Check the deployed version before routing customer requests to it.

cues.title: Open the serving route
cues.text: Deployment complete. Verification complete. Now the release is live.
